title: Ruthless Grape Drank Shortfill 100ml E-Liquid
description: Grape Drank by Ruthless delivers a bold and nostalgic flavour experience, blending the deep, syrupy sweetness of ripe Grape with the effervescent fizz of classic Grape Soda. The result is a smooth yet vibrant vape with layers of juicy fruit and a sparkling soda twist, making it perfect for vapers who enjoy full-bodied, candy-like flavours with a refreshing edge. One of many incredible flavours found in the celebrated Ruthless Shortfill collection, Grape Drank features a 70VG/30PG ratio for dense vapour production and a well-rounded flavour experience. Designed for Sub-Ohm vape kits and advanced DTL (direct-to-lung) devices, it comes in a 100ml shortfill bottle with space for two 10ml nicotine shots, allowing for a customisable nicotine strength. Ruthless has built a reputation for bold, unmistakable flavours that push the boundaries of e-liquid, combining premium ingredients with expert craftsmanship. Their iconic blends remain a top choice for vapers seeking high-quality, unforgettable flavour experiences.
